purpose: Inspect and freeze the official San Francisco Fed Proxy Funds Rate source structure before any model outcome is evaluated.
rules: Only official San Francisco Fed page-linked source files may be used in A0.
Do not run EFFR-vs-Proxy model comparisons in this commit.
Do not load Treasury, T-bill, equity, gold or portfolio outcomes.
Do not infer a monthly series by positional guess if the workbook schema is ambiguous.
If workbook structure changes, fail closed and inspect the new schema.
allowed_outputs: first rows / column labels as schema metadata only
